name: Skanderbeg
contribution: An Albanian nobleman and military leader who led the League of Lezhë in the Ottoman-Albanian Wars until his death.
legacy: This person ranks high in the military history of that time as the most persistent—and ever-victorious—opponent of the Ottoman Empire during its heyday.
image_credit: Antonio Maria Crespi Castoldi · Public domain

checks.lead: Gjergj Kastrioti (also known as Skanderbeg; c. 1405 – 17 January 1468) was an Albanian nobleman and military leader who led the League of Lezhë in the Ottoman-Albanian Wars until his death. Skanderbeg is considered to be a major figure of medieval Albanian history and today is the national hero of Albania.
